### What is 4R/um?

**4R/um** is the internal monthly R exchange meeting and community of practice at **Statistics Denmark** (Danmarks Statistik / DST).

The name plays with the four R's, the most prominent being **REPRODUCIBILITY**, fostering open collaboration, modern scientific publishing, and knowledge sharing around open source data science tools.

### Meeting Format & Logistics

- **Frequency**: Typically held on the **4th Friday of each month**.
- **Location**: In-person at Statistics Denmark and hybrid when possible.
- **Audience**: Open to all colleagues across DST interested in R, from newcomers taking their first steps to seasoned developers.
- **Guest Sessions**: We periodically host guest lectures and joint sessions with external developer communities, such as the *CopenhagenR useR Group*.

### Materials & Repository

- **Internal Drive**: Meeting materials, scripts, and slide decks are mirrored on the DST internal network at:
  ```
  Q:/Rforum
  ```
- **Public GitHub Repository**: Curated, open-source materials, public presentations, and links are made available on GitHub at [github.com/ikashnitsky/4Rum](https://github.com/ikashnitsky/4Rum).

::: {.clearfix}
:::

### Contact & Contributions

Organized by Ilya Kashnitsky and the **Data Science Lab** at [Statistics Denmark (dst.dk)](https://www.dst.dk). If you have an R project, an interesting package, or a case study you would like to present at an upcoming 4R/um meeting, reach out or open an issue on the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ikashnitsky/4Rum).
